content:
You have just started. Your assignment (recorded on the board as #3 for @tidy):

You own project docs and file housekeeping for the Blender project at d:\项目session\blender-supercar: README.md, LATEST/README.txt, docs/README_V5.md, and moving or deleting redundant files. Do NOT edit pipeline/v5_env.py or pipeline/v5_anim.py (worker `env` owns them) and do not touch the .blend files while env is rebuilding.

Start now (safe in parallel):
1. pipeline/v5_organize.py is superseded by step 13 of v5_env.py. Move it to archive/scripts/ (create a v5 subfolder) and remove references to it in README.md.
2. Fix stale facts in docs/README_V5.md: section 7 lists `pipeline/v5_stage_env.blend` / `pipeline/v5_stage_anim.blend`, but they live in LATEST/. Several places say "25 机位" but there are 26 cameras. Section 7 does not mention the clay files (v5_clay.py, render_clay.py, mux_clay.sh, LATEST/v5_stage_anim_clay.blend) or v5_viewport_fast.py. README.md line 9 says LATEST holds only two files, but it also holds the clay blend.
3. Draft (do not yet write the final numbers) a short "编辑指南 / editing guide" section for README.md and LATEST/README.txt. It should explain that each stand, bridge, screen, brake-board group, marshal post and the gantry has an Empty parent, so you select the Empty and press G/R to move the whole assembly; that repeated small parts are merged per stand; and the collection list V5_01..V5_07.

Wait for @env's final summary (it comes after the verifier passes). Then:
4. Update the docs with the real object counts and what changed, plus a section-9-style entry in README_V5.md for the "441 objects piled at origin" bug (cause: matrix_world read before depsgraph update; fix: view_layer.update()).
5. Delete redundant model files: LATEST/*.blend1, pipeline/v4_stage_rig.blend1, and the stale copy _unrelated/新建文件夹/v5_stage_env.blend. Before deleting, confirm that LATEST/v5_stage_env.blend, v5_stage_anim.blend and v5_stage_anim_clay.blend all exist and are newer. Keep pipeline/v4_stage_rig.blend (it is the pipeline input) and everything in archive/.
Post a list of changed, moved and deleted files to @coordinator.
